key_insight: GANet reports 99.99% accuracy on PlantVillage with only 0.001M parameters, targeting lightweight plant disease identification.
engineering_relevance: Its compact architecture supports on-device crop monitoring where computing power and energy are constrained.
method: Group Attention block for feature processing.
Group-Wise Feature Fusion block for sparse, efficient computation.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports evaluation across 38 plant disease types on PlantVillage and deployment speeds of 5 FPS on Raspberry Pi 4b and 11 FPS on Jetson Nano.
watch_item: Performance on diverse field images remains unestablished by the abstract; near-perfect benchmark accuracy may not translate to real-world conditions.
paper_title: GANet: A Lightweight Group Attention Network for Plant Disease Identification on Embedded Systems
